description: Bun.serve with the experimental `http2: true` flag, no framework on top. Two listeners off one config: TLS on 8443 where ALPN picks h2, and cleartext on 8082 where Bun switches a connection on the HTTP/2 preface (prior-knowledge h2c). Routes, JSON shape and static handler are the plain bun entry's, so the delta against it is the protocol. One process per core sharing both ports through reusePort. Needs Bun > 1.4.0 for the server-side flag.
